packageRules.description: Keep the opcli git dependency (tox.ini) and the canonical/charm-ci reusable workflow refs (.github/workflows) in lockstep, since they must always point at the same charm-ci release.

Bump the otel core/exporter modules together with the contrib bridges/instrumentation that compile against their API (e.g. otelslog against otel/log), since Renovate otherwise groups them separately by source repo and a skewed bridge version fails the build.
